thread.title: Technology Sector Update for 12/18/2018: MRIN, GOOGL, DPW, ORCL, MSFT, IBM, AAPL, CSCO, GOOG

author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 12/18/2018: MRIN, GOOGL, DPW, ORCL, MSFT, IBM, AAPL, CSCO, GOOG
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: +0.60%
AAPL: +0.83%
IBM: +0.96%
CSCO: +0.68%
GOOG: +1.30%
Technology stocks were advancing pre-market Tuesday.
Stocks moving on news include:
(+) Marin Software ( MRIN ), which was surging by more than 34% after announcing that it expects Q4 revenue of $14.6 million to $15.1 million and non-GAAP loss from operations of $2.9 million to $2.4 million, after it secured a three-year revenue sharing agreement with Google ( GOOGL ) to further develop Marin's enterprise tech platform and software products.
(+) DPW Holdings ( DPW ) was up more than 3% after its board approved the separate listing and initial public offering of the company's DPW Technology Group, which houses DPW Holdings' defense, aerospace, electronics and power solutions businesses.
(+) Oracle ( ORCL ) was higher by more than 4% as it released Q3 non-GAAP EPS guidance of between $0.86 and $0.88 per share, vs. expectations of $0.84 per share. Oracle also reported Q2 non-GAAP earnings of $0.80 per share, up from $0.69 per share a year ago and better than the analyst consensus of $0.78 per share on Capital IQ.
